name: society-mgmt-300k
description: Synthetic society management code corpus (~300k LOC of vanilla JavaScript) used as a backprop integration test project. Generated standalone functions with no module wiring, no runtime dependencies, and no executable entry point.

scripts.extract:src: python3 -c "import zipfile; zipfile.ZipFile('society_mgmt_300k.zip').extractall('.'); print('extracted source from society_mgmt_300k.zip')"
scripts.build: find src -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check && echo 'build OK: all src files passed node --check'
scripts.lint: echo 'No linter configured: vanilla JS corpus, no eslint/tsconfig present.'
scripts.start: node -e "console.log('No runnable entry point: this is a synthetic code corpus (no server/CLI).')"
